description: For substitutions \(\sigma,\tau:\mathbb N\to\operatorname{Term}_L(A)\), their combined substitution sends \(2n\) to \(\sigma(n)\) and \(2n+1\) to \(\tau(n)\), using parity and integer quotient by two.
